object.name: evi.4wave~
object.digest: Anti-aliased Saw, Rect, Tri and Sine simultaneous oscillators
object.description: Phase synchronous shared frequency oscillators with simultaneous Saw, Rect, Tri and Sine outputs. Anti-aliasing method is 4-point polyblep.

inlets.description: Reset is naive and not anti-aliased.

outlets.description: Anti-aliased Saw oscillator in sync with other outputs
Anti-aliased Rect oscillator in sync with other outputs
Anti-aliased Tri oscillator in sync with other outputs
Anti-aliased Sine oscillator in sync with other outputs, the sine is not pure and has an additional harmonic.
Phase of oscillators for synchronising processes downstream.

attributes.name: zerosync
attributes.description: If on, tri phase is aligned at zero crossings with the other three oscillators. If off (slightly cheaper) tri phase is at the peak of the tri shape.
